name: I need my bathtub removed soon — what should I do first?
description: Start with a quote based on photos or an in-home visit. The contractor needs to see the tub, access, and disposal needs before giving a realistic removal plan.

mainEntity.name: I need my bathtub removed soon — what should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest first step is to get an on-site or photo-based estimate so the contractor can identify the tub type, access issues, and whether disposal is included. In many Denver-area jobs, pricing can often be quoted quickly once photos or a brief walkthrough are available.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with a quote based on photos or an in-home visit. The contractor needs to see the tub, access, and disposal needs before giving a realistic removal plan.
